artifacts.summary: Research on adding hooks/detect-noop-bash.sh: precedent-mapped structure (validate-meta-write.sh advisory shape, claude-stop-notify.sh per-session .claude/tmp state, guard-destructive-git.sh command-parsing technique, test-guard-destructive-git.sh test shape), classification rules, threshold/reset design options, and manifest/settings-hooks.json registration points.

memory_candidates.content: This repo's per-session hook state convention (never under specs/) is `.claude/tmp/<purpose>-<CC_SESSION_ID>`, keyed off the hook stdin JSON's `.session_id` field, created via `mkdir -p "$SCRIPT_DIR/../tmp" 2>/dev/null || true`. Precedent: hooks/claude-stop-notify.sh, hooks/events-log-lifecycle.sh, hooks/wezterm-preflight-status.sh. Do not confuse with the separate specs/tmp/-based GLOBAL (non-session-scoped) cooldown pattern used by hooks/memory-nudge.sh and hooks/tts-notify.sh, which is inside specs/ and not per-session.

hooks/guard-destructive-git.sh's technique for safely pattern-matching a Bash tool_input.command string: strip quoted spans with `sed -z 's/"[^"]*"/""/g' ... "s/'[^']*'/''/g"` (slurp mode so multi-line quotes are handled), then strip bash comments with a second line-mode sed pass, then split on `;`/`&`/`|` into segments before regex-matching each segment. This is the reusable, reviewed way to avoid false positives from tokens embedded in quoted strings/comments or from one non-trivial segment of an otherwise-trivial compound command.

A hooks/*.sh script's regression test lives at scripts/tests/test-<script-under-test>.sh even when the script under test is in hooks/ not scripts/ (precedent: scripts/tests/test-guard-destructive-git.sh tests hooks/guard-destructive-git.sh). Both the new hook and its test must be registered in manifest.json: the hook in provides.hooks (alphabetical), the test in provides.scripts as "tests/test-<name>.sh".
